To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the problem of information quality in information fusion has been studied in a limited way; there are many open research questions; and the research on information quality should be extended to include the information quality in the information fusion process.

information quality is a critical issue for information fusion, that information quality should be considered at the design stage, and that information quality can be represented in the form of a multi-dimensional quality space.

information quality in fusion is a multi-dimensional concept that can be represented by a set of attributes and that the quality of information in a decision support system can be improved by applying a set of methods that can be organized into three categories: methods of data quality improvement, methods of data quality representation and methods of data quality compensation.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and evaluation of methods and tools to support information fusion for decision making in complex dynamic situations, and in particular for decision making in the context of information warfare.
developing the theory and practice of information quality management for information fusion.

the following issues: 1) the representation and assessment of information quality, 2) the design of information quality management systems for information fusion applications, and 3) the integration of the quality management system into the overall information fusion system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the problem is not solved yet and requires further research.
the information quality problem is a difficult problem, and it is a difficult problem because it is a difficult and complex problem.
information quality in information fusion is a difficult problem that is not fully understood yet.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the problem of designing information fusion systems that would be able to provide decision makers with information of high quality, is a complex and multi-faceted one.

we have been developing a theory of information quality, which is based on the idea that information quality is a property of information objects and that information quality is defined by the information object's relation to its context.

the quality of information in information fusion is an essential part of the quality of the fusion process, and that the quality of the information fusion system is an essential part in the quality of decision making.
The main takeaway from our work is that

information quality is not just a property of data, it is also a property of the context and the purpose of information exchange, and thus the information quality assessment and compensation should be done at multiple levels.

information quality is an important factor to be taken into account in information fusion and should be represented as a set of information quality attributes, each of which can be measured and evaluated by the fusion system.
the problem of information quality in information fusion is a very complex one and it is important to consider it in the context of the whole information environment.
